name: Poisonous

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Poisonous: A living creature that comes into
physical contact with the ink must get a success
on a Strength challenge roll or become poisoned
for 1 minute. At the end of each round, the
creature must repeat the roll, taking 1d6 damage
for each failure.
